labels.name: refactor
labels.description: Code or architecture improvement without changing intended behavior

milestones.title: M1 — Backend Foundation
milestones.description: Establish the NestJS modular-monolith foundation, configuration, PostgreSQL/TypeORM, migrations, and testing infrastructure.

issues.title: Establish backend module structure
issues.body: Define the initial NestJS modular-monolith structure for backend modules, common code, configuration, and database infrastructure.

issues.title: Configure application configuration
issues.body: Set up ConfigModule and environment-driven configuration. No hard-coded credentials or environment-specific secrets.

issues.title: Configure TypeORM and PostgreSQL
issues.body: Configure TypeORM for PostgreSQL with entity discovery and separate development/test configuration. Do not use synchronize=true.

issues.title: Establish database migration workflow
issues.body: Add reliable migration generate, run, and revert workflows.

issues.title: Add backend testing foundation
issues.body: Set up unit and integration testing, including an integration-test database strategy.

milestones.title: M2 — Authentication & Authorization
milestones.description: Establish the security boundary, API-key authentication, ownership checks, and isolation tests.

issues.title: Design User persistence model
issues.body: Define the users table/entity and ownership relationship to projects.

issues.title: Design API key persistence
issues.body: Persist API keys securely using hashes. Never store recoverable raw API keys.

issues.title: Implement API key authentication
issues.body: Implement Bearer API-key authentication and resolve the authenticated user.

issues.title: Implement authorization boundary
issues.body: Enforce authenticated-user ownership/access across Project → Experiment → Generation resources.

issues.title: Add authentication and isolation tests
issues.body: Test valid/invalid/missing keys and cross-user resource isolation.

milestones.title: M3 — Project & Experiment Vertical Slice
milestones.description: Build the first end-to-end slice from SDK/HTTP request through NestJS, persistence, authorization, and PostgreSQL.

issues.title: Define Project database model
issues.body: Implement the Project persistence model with User ownership.

issues.title: Implement Project repository
issues.body: Create the repository abstraction and TypeORM persistence implementation for projects.

issues.title: Implement Project creation use case
issues.body: Implement authenticated project creation with validation and persistence.

issues.title: Implement Project retrieval and listing
issues.body: Implement project retrieval/listing with ownership enforcement.

issues.title: Define Experiment database model
issues.body: Implement Experiment persistence and its Project relationship.

issues.title: Implement Experiment CRUD
issues.body: Implement experiment creation, retrieval, and listing with project ownership enforcement.

issues.title: SDK → API → PostgreSQL integration test
issues.body: Prove the existing Python SDK can create and retrieve real Project/Experiment data through the backend.

milestones.title: M4 — Generation Provenance
milestones.description: Implement the central Generation provenance object, lifecycle, immutability boundary, and existing SDK contract.

issues.title: Define Generation persistence model
issues.body: Implement generations with generator, parameters JSONB, reproducibility metadata, lifecycle, timestamps, and metadata.

issues.title: Implement Generation creation
issues.body: Implement POST /experiments/:experimentId/generations with authorization and validation.

issues.title: Implement Generation retrieval and listing
issues.body: Implement GET /generations/:id and GET /experiments/:experimentId/generations.

issues.title: Implement Generation lifecycle
issues.body: Enforce pending → running → completed/failed and reject invalid transitions.

issues.title: Enforce Generation provenance immutability
issues.body: Freeze provenance fields once a generation enters RUNNING while allowing operational lifecycle fields to change.

issues.title: Integrate Generation API with existing SDK
issues.body: Validate the real SDK 0.1.0 contract against the backend, including creation, retrieval, listing, and lifecycle updates.

milestones.title: M5 — Dataset & Asset Provenance
milestones.description: Implement reusable logical datasets/assets, immutable versions, and role-aware provenance references.

issues.title: Implement Dataset and DatasetVersion
issues.body: Implement logical Dataset plus immutable DatasetVersion with URI, version, checksum, format, size, and metadata.

issues.title: Implement GenerationDatasetReference
issues.body: Implement the role-aware many-to-many relationship between Generation and exact DatasetVersion records.

issues.title: Implement Asset and AssetVersion
issues.body: Implement logical Asset plus immutable AssetVersion for reusable generator inputs.

issues.title: Implement GenerationAssetReference
issues.body: Implement the role-aware many-to-many relationship between Generation and exact AssetVersion records.

issues.title: Add provenance integrity tests
issues.body: Test immutable versions, reusable resources, exact-version references, roles, and failed-generation preservation.

milestones.title: M6 — Training & Evaluation Lineage
milestones.description: Connect generated dataset versions to training runs and exact evaluation dataset versions.

issues.title: Implement TrainingRun
issues.body: Implement training-run persistence and lifecycle within an Experiment.

issues.title: Implement TrainingRunDatasetReference
issues.body: Allow TrainingRuns to consume multiple exact DatasetVersions through a role-aware reference table.

issues.title: Implement EvaluationResult
issues.body: Implement evaluation results with metrics, configuration, metadata, timestamps, and TrainingRun relationship.

issues.title: Link EvaluationResult to exact DatasetVersion
issues.body: Record the exact DatasetVersion used for evaluation.

issues.title: Implement lineage queries
issues.body: Support traversal from EvaluationResult to TrainingRun, DatasetVersion, Generation, parameters, and assets.

issues.title: Add end-to-end lineage tests
issues.body: Verify Generation → DatasetVersion → TrainingRun → EvaluationResult lineage can be persisted and retrieved.

milestones.title: M7 — Search, Comparison & Reproduction
milestones.description: Expose useful queries over stored provenance and generate reproduction/documentation manifests.

issues.title: Implement experiment and run search
issues.body: Add practical filtering by project, experiment, generator, time, name, and supported metadata.

issues.title: Implement parameter filtering
issues.body: Support useful structured parameter filtering without introducing a generalized query language.

issues.title: Implement experiment comparison
issues.body: Provide comparison views/queries over existing generations and downstream results. Do not create a separate Comparison entity.

issues.title: Implement reproduction manifest generation
issues.body: Generate a structured manifest containing generator, parameters, seed, code/environment metadata, assets, dataset versions, hashes, and missing/external dependencies.

issues.title: Implement documentation export
issues.body: Generate structured research/reproducibility documentation from stored provenance.

milestones.title: M8 — Production Hardening & Deployment
milestones.description: Harden the API for reliable use, CI, deployment, observability, and recovery.

issues.title: Define API error taxonomy
issues.body: Standardize validation, authentication, authorization, not-found, conflict, semantic validation, and internal errors.

issues.title: Implement idempotency and safe retries
issues.body: Make retryable registration/capture operations safe against duplicate submissions.

issues.title: Add pagination and API filtering
issues.body: Prevent unbounded list responses and support practical API filtering.

issues.title: Add structured logging and secret redaction
issues.body: Implement structured logs and ensure API keys/secrets never appear in logs or errors.

issues.title: Add health and readiness endpoints
issues.body: Add cheap health and dependency-aware readiness endpoints.

issues.title: Document and test database backup/restore
issues.body: Establish and validate metadata backup and recovery procedures.

issues.title: Build CI pipeline
issues.body: Run lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests, and build on GitHub Actions.

issues.title: Deploy backend to Render
issues.body: Deploy the MVP backend with environment-based secrets and PostgreSQL connectivity.

issues.title: Run deployed SDK integration test
issues.body: Run the actual Python SDK against the deployed backend.

milestones.title: M9 — Real Research Pilot
milestones.description: Validate SynthGraph against the co-founder's actual synthetic-data workflow and turn findings into an evidence-based backlog.

issues.title: Instrument real synthetic-data workflow
issues.body: Run the actual research generation workflow through the SDK and backend.

issues.title: Validate provenance completeness
issues.body: Check whether captured provenance answers what exactly produced a dataset.

issues.title: Validate reproduction workflow
issues.body: Use a recorded experiment to test whether the manifest provides enough information for reconstruction.

issues.title: Validate lineage
issues.body: Verify Generation → DatasetVersion → TrainingRun → EvaluationResult is understandable and retrievable.

issues.title: Record integration problems and contract mismatches
issues.body: Capture real workflow failures and contract mismatches as explicit follow-up issues.
